_about: Models actually matched to a dealer listing, with the last day and price we saw. The site keeps an indexable /model/<key>/ page for retain_days after last_seen, then drops it. A last price is kept only when the listing still classifies as that model, and only when it is at least a quarter of the 90-day median (or of the catalog median, when the 90-day one is missing). Written by scraper/run.py. Prices are copied from listings or listing state, never estimated.
